recommendation: Keep the fixed commit. No further FHIR-core change is needed for CapabilityStatement.operation.name unless a future work-group decision revisits the naming model more broadly.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core clarification asking that CapabilityStatement.rest.[resource.]operation.name be treated as the invocation name that normally matches OperationDefinition.code, and that OperationDefinition.code describe the recommended operation invocation URL name.
initial_application: Commit df39949a59ceb5924608a99ba9f3251679b12166 explicitly applied FHIR-34234. It correctly expanded CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.operation.name, but the OperationDefinition.code text retained copied SearchParameter concepts: a 'search url' short description and a definition referring to multiple SearchParameters.
additional_context: FHIR-27755 is the SearchParameter/CapabilityStatement precedent that FHIR-34234 mirrors. FHIR-36559 is a narrower same-family CapabilityStatement clarification already represented on the combined branch, and the current CapabilityStatement source preserves that correction. The Zulip thread cited by Jira confirms the intended model: OperationDefinition.code is the default invocation token, while CapabilityStatement.operation.name is the server-advertised token when disambiguation is needed. FHIR-34235 is the companion Bulk Data IG issue and is outside this core checkout.
reconciliation: Changed the active OperationDefinition StructureDefinition so OperationDefinition.code is the recommended name for an operation invocation URL and refers to multiple OperationDefinitions, not SearchParameters. Updated the OperationDefinition pattern-mapping exception and checked-in SVG tooltip to keep companion/generated surfaces consistent with the authoritative XML.

source/operationdefinition/operationdefinition-definition-mapping-exceptions.xml: updated the mirrored OperationDefinition.code mapping exception text.
